name: plan-handoff
about: Plans, the hand-off half of scenario 2 (docs/phases/07-planning.md), through the API: the brief and a blueprint with 3 pieces (2 and 3 depend on 1) are approved; in the same transaction loopd files 3 items (source plan, P2, plan_id, plan_piece, depends_on mapped to the new ids) and the plan goes to split. The items are posted to #loop as usual, 2 and 3 'waiting on #1'. Only piece 1 is claimable: the runner claims it, it asks a question, and then the runner has nothing to do.
